# Pricing & Packaging

`pricing-and-packaging` · v1.2.0 · Design · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/pricing-and-packaging/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Do our tiers and price points hold together, where does revenue come from, and what would a price change do to it?

**Inputs:** The ICP/segments and what each values, the differentiator, proof, rough willingness to pay, competitor pricing, and for each tier its price and customers, with seats, usage, the share who pay yearly and the cost to serve when you have them.

**Output:** A value metric, good-better-best tiers with prices, modeled MRR, ARR, blended ARPU and revenue mix, the price ladder and anchor check, gross margin when costs are given, a what-if for a price or mix change with its break-even, and the upgrade logic.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill pricing-and-packaging`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://mcp.aajconsult.com/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/pricing-and-packaging/resources/price-packaging.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/pricing-and-packaging/resources/price-packaging.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON. It can read an input file you name on the command line; it reads nothing else.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It does the arithmetic on the tiers you enter: MRR, ARPU, revenue mix, price steps, the anchor and margin. It can't tell you what buyers will pay, which value metric fits, or how many customers a price change will lose.
- A what-if counts every customer on a tier as average. A break-even is how many customers a tier can lose or must add, not a forecast of how many will. A customer who moves tier is counted at the average of the tier they join.
- The 1.5x weak-anchor line and the 1.6x ARPU line are AAJ's rules of thumb, not published benchmarks. For a product with no customers, the mix is your estimate, so every figure is an assumption.
- Seats, usage, annual share and cost are averages you supply for each tier. MRR spreads a yearly payment over twelve months, so it is not cash received. The engine does not model churn over time, taxes or currencies.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns pricing checks the tier prices, the customer mix and the per-tier averages, marked as estimates if projected, and owns the customers-lost number in any what-if. The finance lead cross-checks the blended ARPU against CAC and payback in unit-economics before any price goes live.
